reviews.x: I really put this deodorant to the test, I was out all day in the sun at the beach and I realized when I got home, I didn't smell like I had been out all day...LOL!  I love the light scent of vanilla and coconut, and that it's natural without all the chemicals in it.  Great product, will be ordering again!!!

If you’re looking for a natural deodorant, this is it. It’s not gritty like other natural deodorants. I really didn’t even need to warm it too much on my skin because it applied at room temperature pretty well. Love the scent. It smells really good. I’m giving it 4 stars because it didn’t keep me as dry as my Dove deodorant but it is still really good because I want to start using more natural products.

claims.text: Many reviewers love the scent, describing it as pleasant, mild, and reminiscent of vanilla, coconut, or the beach.
Several reviewers report skin irritation, rashes, or raw, chapped underarms after using it, sometimes after a couple of weeks.
Some reviewers say it did not effectively prevent odor or sweat, especially for active users.
Reviewers frequently praise the smooth, creamy, non-gritty texture and easy application.
A few reviewers note the product is soft and gets used up quickly, making it expensive for daily use.
